title: dogfood: main's Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3) is red since #25956 — the authz blind-spot census still pins `handleI18nRequest` at 3 in packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts; #25956 made it 4
body:
Filing gate ③: **maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, 2026-10-26 08:01Z: 「main 上的 `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` 时红时绿，跟合仓无关，还没有 issue 跟踪」. Filed by the devx seat (seat post #6023, session `session_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd`). The claim follows separately.

**Business reason:** `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` is red on every `main` run that runs it, starting at #25956 (06:42Z today). The release gate (`full-battery`) reads those runs. A red full battery at the version commit refuses a cut, and every red push run also re-files #25438.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:devx`. `packages/qa/dogfood` is the QA harness, and the server lane is not seated today. One small PR.

## It looks intermittent, but it is a deterministic red

The red comes from one assertion. It fails the same way on every run that runs shard 3/3:

```
FAIL [isolated] test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts > authz probe blind-spot census (#13260)
  > packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts — every positive control is still present in THAT file
AssertionError: control "handleI18nRequest" moved in packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts: expected 4 to be 3
```

- **Cause:** `69fa23d60b` (#25956, Part of #25785, server card thread). It added a 4th occurrence of `handleI18nRequest` to `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`. On `origin/main` the file holds 4 occurrences (lines 20 and 73 are docblock `{@link handleI18nRequest}`, 150 is the call, 155 is the declaration); at `37617109` it held 3. `PROBE_FILE_CENSUS` still records 3.
- **Why it looks intermittent:** a `push` run on `main` is affected-only (#16467), so a merge that does not touch the dogfood closure skips the `Dogfood Regression Gate (N/3)` legs. The aggregate is then green, for example 0c372288's run 40282257384. `pull_request` and `merge_group` never run the dogfood legs at all (#24073), which is how #25956 merged green.
- **Reproduced locally on `origin/main` `cdd4eea938`:** `npx vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` in `packages/qa/dogfood` → `1 failed | 46 passed`, the same assertion.

Before 69fa23d6, the 3/3 leg was green on all 56 `main` runs from 2026-10-25 05:57Z to 06:40Z today that ran it. The red `CI` conclusions in that window came from other jobs (#25438 tracks those).

## Wanted

- The census is a **measurement pin**. Its own header says that whoever moves a count re-reads it, so don't just bump the number. Read the 4th occurrence. If it is only the new docblock `{@link}` and the probe's reach is unchanged (the population and reachable rows for `i18n.ts` still pass today), record 4 and say so in the PR body.
- If the new code added a handler or route that the probe should see, stop and report it. That is a census row change, not a count bump.
- Check whether any other control or row in `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` moved with #25956 or with later merges. Run the whole `packages/qa/dogfood` shard 3/3 locally (or the census + `authz-conformance` files) before you push.
- Acceptance: `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` is green on the first `main` push run after landing that runs it, and on the next scheduled run. Report the run ids on this card.

## Not in scope

- Making PR or merge-group CI run the dogfood legs. That was ruled on in #24073 / #22653, and is a separate decision.
- The ui-merge Test UI red (`check-pre-install-import-graph`, `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`), which is #25957 / #25712.
